name: Lane Broadbent
biography: Lane Broadbent is a Security Engineer performing threat hunting and full stack security engineering for Vivint, a tech company focused on IoT and home security. With over a decade of experience in research, pen testing, and jack of all trades systems administration, Lane now works to secure IoT devices and the systems that interact with them. In his free time, Lane tries to best the corporate NTP pool with parts salvaged from thrift stores.
